ma.getLaunchOptionsSync(Object object)

Get the startup parameters when starting the Mini Program (minimum version: 23.12.0)

Return Value

Object object

Attribute Type Description
serviceConfig Array Startup parameters issued by the server

Array serviceConfig

Object ArrayItem
Attribute Type Description
configName String Configuration Item Name
configValue String Configuration Item Value

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program SaaS platform

Sample Code

const { serviceConfig } = ma.getLaunchOptionsSync();
console.log(serviceConfig[0].configName);
console.log(serviceConfig[0].configValue);



// serviceConfig example
serviceConfig = [
  {
    configName: "id",
    configValue: "123456"
  }
]
